data.summary: The antipope Felix V grants Paris de Fossano, a canon of the Monastery of St. Peter of Manzario, the priorate of St. Andrew of Savilliaro, reserving a pension of 60 ducats for Cardinal Bernard of the Four Crowns, and orders the bishops of Lausanne and Belluno to induct him into possession.
